slides.idea: How does a Studio topic live, from a chat to closed?
slides.content: The figure drawn from JL's ladder sketch (261029): the work ladder with rungs Block b17, Job j01, Task t03; a chat on a rung makes the folder b17.j01.t03-s09; it holds Items, MindMap, Slides, passes (previous chats); next chat: one more pass; then agreed, delivery/ v2, closed.
slides.notes: A chat on any rung makes the topic; it holds Items, MindMap, Slides, passes; each chat is a pass; then agreed, delivery/, closed.

slides.idea: How does a Studio topic live, from the first question to delivery?
slides.content:
A labelled flow diagram: every box names an actor or an output, every arrow says what moves.
Title (top, centred, large): "The life of a Studio topic"
Subtitle under it: "The Agent goes round with the Human on one thing until it is good"
Top row, three actors:
 left, a person thinking with a small question mark, box "HUMAN", under it "An open question; says agreed"
 centre, a friendly robot holding a slide, box "AGENT", under it "Draws options, keeps the record"
 right, a stack of charts and tables, box "THE WORK", under it "Task results, Runs, related/"
Arrows between HUMAN and AGENT: an upper arrow pointing to HUMAN labelled "Idea slides + options"; a lower arrow pointing to AGENT labelled "Choices + red marks"
Arrows between AGENT and THE WORK: an upper arrow pointing to AGENT labelled "Results + figures"; a lower arrow pointing to THE WORK labelled "Read results, ask for a Run"
Under the AGENT, an orange bracket labelled "Each round adds to two linked outputs" over two boxes joined by a two-way arrow labelled "Align":
 left box "DECIDED", under it "One line each, with the Human's words"
 right box "RESULT/", under it "Drafts and trial pictures, messy is fine"
Bottom row: a box "AGREED VERSION", under it "The Human says it is good", then a purple arrow labelled "Clean copy, v2" to a box "DELIVERY/", under it "Handed over; the topic closes"
A blue arrow from AGREED VERSION back up to the AGENT, labelled "Not yet: another round"
Footer, small: "Each round is saved as passes/pNN-MMDD"
slides.notes: Human, Agent and the work; each round adds to Decided and result/; the agreed version is copied clean to delivery/ and the topic closes. Still open: who says agreed; is a closed topic kept or deleted?

slides.idea: How do we define a Studio?
slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "What is a Studio: a folder, a room, or the talk?"
Three option cards across the middle, joined by a wavy line:
 Card A, label "A folder": an open folder holding small drawings; caption "studio/ in a Block"
 Card B, label "A room": an open door to a small desk; caption "a place beside Report and Work"
 Card C, label "The talk", circled with a thick orange marker loop and a small hand-written tag "leaning": two speech bubbles going round a question mark in a loop; caption "rounds on one open question"
Bottom-right mustard sticky note with a big question mark: "Still open: one topic, or all of them?"
Focal point: card C.
slides.notes: Options: a folder; a room; the discussion itself (leaning). Still open: is a Studio one topic or all of a Block's topics?

slides.idea: What does a Studio topic hold?
slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "One topic, five ways to look at it"
A hand-drawn open box in the centre labelled "s05", with five things rising out of it, the first one largest:
 a stack of slide cards labelled "Ideas" (largest, circled with a thick orange marker loop, small tag "first")
 a sketch canvas with a pencil labelled "Drawing"
 a small tree of circles labelled "Mind map"
 a calendar page with two dots labelled "Rounds"
 a small name card labelled "Face"
Bottom-right mustard sticky note with a big question mark: "Still open: is a Decided list just bookkeeping?"
Focal point: Ideas.
slides.notes: Ideas, Drawing, Mind map, Rounds, Face. Leaning: Ideas first. Still open: is the face's Decided list bookkeeping?

slides.idea: What is inside a studio/ folder?
slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "What is inside studio/?"
Left: a big hand-drawn open folder labelled "studio/" with five small topic folders sticking out, their tabs reading "s01", "s02", "s04", "s05", "s32".
Right: one topic folder opened wide, labelled "sNN-topic/", with six things laid out in two rows, each a small doodle with a short label:
 a name card "face"
 a lightbulb on a note "ideas"
 a stack of picture cards "slides/"
 a sketch canvas with a pencil "drawing"
 a small tree of circles "mind map"
 a calendar page "passes/"
Below them, a small grey tray with a gear doodle, labelled "made by scripts: previews, decks"
Bottom-right mustard sticky note with a big question mark: "Still open: are mock/ and assets/ allowed?"
Focal point: the opened topic folder.
slides.notes: A Block's studio/ holds one folder per topic (sNN-<topic>/), plus _build/ (shared builder helpers) and loose drawings. A topic holds: face .md, .ideas.md, slides/, .slides.json, .excalidraw, .mindmap.md, passes/pNN-MMDD/pass.md, and when a script draws it build_sNN_<topic>.py with .sNN-<topic>.seed.json, plus history/. Made by scripts, git-ignored or rebuilt: .png, .mindmap.html, .slides.html, .slides.pptx. Still open: b17-s04 also holds mock/, assets/ and extra drawings the contract does not name.

slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "One Block, four doors"
Four hand-drawn doors in a row, each a different colour, each with a short label above and a tiny doodle inside:
 door 1, sage green, label "related/": an envelope coming in; caption "came in"
 door 2, soft orange, larger than the rest, label "studio/": a speech bubble and a pencil; caption "think"
 door 3, light blue, label "reports/": a notebook with a tick; caption "answer"
 door 4, mustard, label "delivery/": a parcel going out; caption "went out"
Bottom-right mustard sticky note with a big question mark: "Still open: does a Job keep its own studio/?"
Focal point: the studio/ door.
slides.notes: related/ came in, studio/ think, reports/ answer, delivery/ went out. Still open: does a Job or Task keep its own studio/ (haipipe-delivery disagrees with itself)?

slides.idea: How does a Studio sit beside related/ and delivery/?
slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "The Studio thinks between in and out?"
Three option cards across the middle, joined by a wavy line:
 Card A, label "A straight line": three boxes "related", "studio", "delivery" joined by arrows; caption "in, think, out"
 Card B, label "Through Work", circled with a thick orange marker loop and a small hand-written tag "leaning": a speech bubble with arrows to a hammer and to a notebook, then to a parcel; caption "an agreed idea leaves through Work or Report"
 Card C, label "Deck as delivery": a slide card handed across a meeting table; caption "the deck itself goes out"
Bottom-right mustard sticky note with a big question mark: "Still open: is a meeting deck a delivery?"
Focal point: card B.
slides.notes: Options: a line; through Work and Report (leaning); the deck as a delivery. Still open: is a deck shown at a meeting a delivery?
